name: South Dakota State Cross Country Championships
where: Rapid City, SD · Hart Ranch Camping Resort
headline: South Dakota state: Reilly and VanDeest run it back
summary: Harrisburg's Brianna Reilly, No. 16 in DyeStat's national rankings, won last year's Class AA girls title in 16:45.92, with Spearfish's Peyton VanDeest (No. 17), now a senior, second. Harrisburg, the defending Class AA team champion and No. 18 nationally, leads the team race at Hart Ranch. The Class AA girls race starts at 2:30 p.m. local time, the boys at 3:15 p.m.
